title: Darkness Overhaul
description: Night is alive. Stay in light.
body:
Darkness Overhaul is a curated modpack designed to transform your Minecraft world into a terrifying and immersive horror survival experience. This pack focuses on atmosphere, fear, and the feeling of never being truly alone.
